maximum_depth_rule: All 257 Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until current values, targets, and annotations can be separated through reviewed source-table mappings.
history_boundary: Plan-history references remain source context. No prior or successor plan series is attached automatically, and mixed statements are not converted into annual actuals or achievement results.
non_goals: Do not infer annual actual and target fields from mixed raw statements.
Do not attach plan-history series without reviewed identity mapping.
Do not replace missing units or merge separate source rows.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
